world: The game is set in a lively harbor town and the countryside around it. Trainers walk a looping road, pass the town square to collect their pay, and catch wild creatures in the tall grass. Friends tease one another with a wink and the odd creature-catching pun, but nobody here is cruel. Talk is friendly, short and light, and it stays about the game at the table.

classHints.main-character: A hopeful newcomer on a first big journey, curious and brave, quick to cheer a good moment.
classHints.rival: A confident challenger who loves a contest and likes to stay a step ahead of the others.
classHints.fisherman: A patient angler who loves the water, speaks slowly and calmly, and trusts steady luck.
classHints.nurse-joy: A caring healer who watches over everyone's creatures and speaks warmly and gently.
classHints.bug-catcher: A cheerful hunter of small crawling creatures, eager and easily delighted.
classHints.researcher: A careful scholar who notes every detail, speaks precisely and wants to understand how things work.
classHints.team-rocket: A sly schemer who enjoys bold plans and keeps every word polite at the table.
classHints.collector: A proud gatherer of rare finds who admires fine things and speaks like a connoisseur.

topics.game_start: The game is just starting and everyone has taken a seat.
